title: A local power witness needs actual surviving taps
statement: Introduced local voltage taps with ±0.05 V error separate wound intervals [4.45,4.55] V and [0.45,0.55] V; with current at least 0.49 A the local-power lower bounds are 2.1805 W and 0.2205 W. This distinguishes the declared pair only if real surviving wiring spans the correct region with the stated geometry and calibration. Local power does not establish material strength or useful force.

evidence.range_scope: Whole supplied ROOT local heating and functional-recovery derivations; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Locate the actual damaged region, retain or isolate mechanical/fluid loads, direct heat without destroying healthy monitoring, recover a bounded cool state and verify useful function and critical stocks. The circuit model assumes two series ohmic elements, fixed current and independent lumped thermal nodes. The gas model assumes ideal air, a declared orifice law, finite isolated stock and known temperature/volume evolution. Apart from the source 0.5 A reference, these values are introduced rather than measured material, sensor or actuator properties.
provides: Introduced local voltage taps with ±0.05 V error separate wound intervals [4.45,4.55] V and [0.45,0.55] V; with current at least 0.49 A the local-power lower bounds are 2.1805 W and 0.2205 W. assumptions: The terminal-only counterexample depends on its stated ohmic and thermal assumptions. Optional taps require actual surviving wiring and calibration; local power still does not prove repair. The closure law is not measured polymer kinetics and cooldown is not a prescribed readiness limit. Surrogate holes are not calibrated cracks. Real creep, force, fatigue, adhesion and stock renewal remain unresolved. The existing source already combines detection, heating, sealing and electrical reset. No new material, sensor algorithm, working device, whole-cost advantage or all-sensor obstruction is established.
costs: Complete 9,663-byte ROOT note 4cf7bb7c with supplied 7,262-byte Python 73a58ec8 and 6,556-byte JSON 8a02e488, preserved unchanged as scientific evidence and not executed by Capital. The original note stays private; the public copy changes only two asset locators. ROOT reports independent derivation/execution. Its actual Krings main manufacturing/validation read scope is retained; figures were not visually inspected and videos/SI/cited originals were not followed. Legrand failed on first access; Guo later access failed without erasing earlier bounded exposure. Every prior source/access/transfer hold persists. No scientific replay, acquisition, experiment, hardware or resource expansion.
contract.units: Source-reported finite chemical, transport, financial, mechanical and measurement quantities at their stated assumptions; no Capital scientific execution.
obstruction: Construct damage-region observability and a complete repair, cooling and load-return operation, with surviving monitoring, calibrated material/gas/thermal behavior, disposition of consumed conductive stock and useful-function/life evidence. A refreshed layer or replacement cartridge remains paid input; disappearance of a short or an isolated pressure observation does not close functional restoration.

review.scope: Whole supplied original available derivations at exact stated scope; reported numerical execution is not physical qualification, a supplier quotation, novelty, an integrated invention or a new independent Capital audit.
